A: Link the runbook on a line `Runbook: <url>`.
The whole message must fit on a pager screen: at most 400 characters, counting spaces and line breaks.
The first line must be `[<SEVERITY>] <service>: <summary>` with the severity in capitals, one of `[CRITICAL]`, `[WARNING]`, `[INFO]`.
Say how long the condition has held on a line `For: <n>m`, in whole minutes.
Name the environment on a line `Env: <name>`.
Give the measurement on a line `Value: <current> (threshold <limit>)`.
B: The first line must be `Alert <ID> firing on <service>`, for example `Alert ALR-7731 firing on checkout-api`.
Describe what customers notice on a line that begins with `User impact: `.
Give the runbook address on its own line in the form `Runbook: <url>`.
Explain how to acknowledge with the line `Ack: reply ack <alert ID>`, for example `Ack: reply ack ALR-7731`.
List at least three likely causes as bullets that start with `- ` under a line that reads exactly `Likely causes:`.
Tell the responder where to start on a line that begins with `First action: `.

relations.reason: The first line cannot be both `[<SEVERITY>] <service>: <summary>` and `Alert <ID> firing on <service>`.
Both require the runbook link on a line `Runbook: <url>`.
A `Likely causes:` line with at least three bullets fits inside the limit of 400 characters only if the causes and every other line are kept very short, unlike the long example of B.

reconciled: List exactly three likely causes as bullets that start with `- ` under a line that reads exactly `Likely causes:`, and keep each cause to a phrase of at most four words. The whole message must fit on a pager screen: at most 400 characters, counting spaces and line breaks, so keep every other line to one short phrase as well.
